entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: A diminutive Soldevi researcher and machinist in Kjeldor who built a weathervane and later tried to make amends for the destruction of Soldev.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: A Kjeldoran city where Arcum Dagsson worked; it was destroyed by out-of-control war beasts.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: The land Soldev belonged to and which Arcum Dagsson wished to aid.

entities.name: Royal Academy of Magic
entities.description: An academy in Krov that held a copy of Arcum's weathervane.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: The city housing the Royal Academy of Magic.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: A character who brought Jodah to see Arcum's weathervane.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: The Archmage Eternal, skeptical of Arcum's weather predictions.

entities.name: Soldevi Adnates
entities.description: Meddlers whose interference caused the war beasts to go out of control.

entities.name: Phyrexian War Beasts
entities.description: Excavated Phyrexian machines that went out of control and destroyed Soldev.

entities.name: Soldevi Steam Beasts
entities.description: Machines built by Arcum and the Soldevi machinists that went out of control.

entities.name: Ice Phyrexians
entities.description: Phyrexians led by Heidar whom Arcum helped stop.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: Ancient war whose artifacts the Soldevi machinists studied.

events.summary: Arcum shows Jodah and Gustha Ebbasdotter his weathervane, predicting a deepening winter; Jodah is skeptical.
events.quote: Although Arcum tried to prove to Jodah that these predictions were true, the Archmage Eternal was skeptical

events.summary: Soldevi machinists, Arcum among them, copy ancient artifact designs; the excavated war beasts and steam beasts go out of control and destroy Soldev.
events.quote: went out of control due to the meddling of the Soldevi Adnates and destroyed the city

events.summary: Arcum devotes his life to atonement, helps stop the Ice Phyrexians, warns Kjeldor, and dies of a heart attack.
events.quote: He died of a heart attack not long after.

relations.note: Played a significant role in stopping them
relations.quote: played a significant role in stopping Heidar
as well as his own Soldevi Steam Beasts
